title: Counterfactual Gate-Support Decomposition: Separating Selection from Redistribution in Training-Data Filtering
abstract: arXiv:2610.19343v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A training-data quality gate changes both which examples survive within regions of the input space and how training mass is distributed across those regions, so a gate-versus-random comparison does not isolate these mechanisms. We introduce Counterfactual Gate-Support Decomposition (CGSD), a four-arm, budget-matched design that crosses gate eligibility with support distribution and decomposes the observed gate effect into within-support selection, between-support redistribution, and their interaction. The practical constraint is finite-pool realizability: we characterize mass and token-assembly conditions under which the required arms can be constructed, together with a support-extinction case in which the ordinary design is undefined. On Korean-English and Korean-Japanese retrieval, the mean within-support selection component is the only one that exceeds its calibrated null band (+29.7 and +5.6 holdout items; 30/30 positive replicates

translated_title: 反事实门控支持分解：在训练数据过滤中分离选择与重分配效应
translated_abstract: 训练数据质量门控会同时改变两个方面的结果：输入空间各区域内哪些样本得以保留，以及训练数据总量在这些区域之间如何分布，因此单纯的“门控与随机”对比无法将这两种机制分离开来。本文提出了反事实门控支持分解方法，这是一种四臂、预算匹配的实验设计，通过将门控资格与支持分布进行交叉组合，把观察到的门控效应分解为支持内选择、支持间重分配以及二者的交互作用。该方法面临的实际约束是有限池可实现性：作者刻画了在何种质量和词元组装条件下才能构建所需的实验臂，并讨论了支持消亡的情形——在此情况下常规设计无法定义。在韩英和韩日检索任务上的实验表明，支持内选择分量的均值是唯一超出其校准零区间的分量（+29.7 和 +5.6 个保留集条目；30/30 次重复均为正向）。
tldr: 该论文提出反事实门控支持分解（CGSD），一种四臂预算匹配的实验设计，可将训练数据质量门控的整体效应分解为支持内选择、支持间重分配及其交互作用，并在韩英与韩日检索任务中发现支持内选择是唯一显著超出校准零区间的分量。
